_rootNote: absolute or repo-relative path to YOUR project. Copy this file to <your-project>/.design/profile.json (preferred, commits with the repo) or <durable-data-dir>/profiles/<project>.json. The bundled copy is a TEMPLATE — never edit it in place; the plugin directory is replaced on update.
_tokenNote: point at an ESM module exporting evaluateGatedPairs() (or TOKENS + GATED_PAIRS) and the contrast gate reuses YOUR real AA contract. No module? Inline `tokens` + `gatedPairs` below and the gate computes contrast from those. TypeScript modules can't be imported — inline instead.
_gatedPairsNote: plain `border` is DECORATIVE (hairlines) and deliberately ungated; `border-strong` is the essential-control border and IS gated at 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). Gate what carries meaning; don't gate hairlines you'd then have to darken into heaviness.
_ownerInvolvementNote: "hands-on" | "autonomous". hands-on = the router adds CHEAP early owner checkpoints BEFORE the expensive stages (confirm register+references after grounding; pick a direction on throwaway mockups before any production tournament; a does-ANY-of-these-reach-your-bar check after the council verdict, before the fix loop). autonomous = the classic loop with exactly ONE final approval gate (the unchanged default). Unset -> the router asks ONE question at run start and offers to record the answer here.
_surfaceTypeNote: "marketing" | "app" | "data" | "email" (optional; default app-like). ONLY "marketing" activates the scope-B surface-triggered lenses in design-evaluate — SEO/share-meta + Performance/CWV budget (references/scope-b-marketing-lenses.md). Never fires perf/SEO budgets on an app/data/email surface.
_register: REPLACE ME — the product's intended feeling, in the owner's own words. This literal string is what the register-fit gate judges against; the council ABSTAIN-BLOCKS without it. Be specific: name the temperature (warm/calm/serious), the density, the tone, what is BANNED (e.g. 'no red except true errors'), and 2-3 comparable products.
_northStars: 2-4 reference products whose craft this project aspires to, with the specific aspect (e.g. 'Linear — restraint and type discipline; Stripe — numeric craft').
_notes: Anything the next design pass should know that the code can't say.
